exam_scheme.note: Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS) conducts teacher selection through a two-stage examination process consisting of a Computer Based Test (CBT) and a Professional Competency Test. The CBT comprises 180 multiple-choice questions (180 marks) of 180 minutes duration across four parts: Part I (Proficiency in Languages), Part II (General Awareness, Reasoning & Computer Literacy), Part III (Perspectives on Education and Leadership), and Part IV (Subject-Specific Syllabus). There is no negative marking. The Professional Competency Test carries 60 marks (30 for Demo Teaching and 30 for Interview). Final selection is based on a composite score with 70% weightage for CBT and 30% weightage for the Professional Competency Test.

financial_package.note: Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan is an autonomous organization under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Teaching cadres are compensated under the central 7th CPC Pay Matrix: PGTs commence at Pay Level 8 (entry basic ₹47,600), TGTs at Pay Level 7 (entry basic ₹44,900), and PRTs at Pay Level 6 (entry basic ₹35,400). Teachers are entitled to standard central allowances, residential campus quarters where available, or applicable HRA.
financial_package.pay_source_label: KVS Advt. No. 15/2022 — Pay Matrix Level 8 (₹47,600 – ₹1,51,100) for Post Graduate Teachers
financial_package.estimate_note: Spans entry PRT at Level 6 basic ₹35,400 (gross ~₹72,000, in-hand ~₹64,000) to PGT at Level 8 basic ₹47,600 in Class X metro (basic ₹47,600 + 58% DA ₹27,608 + 30% HRA ₹14,280 + TPTA ₹5,688 = gross ~₹95,176, in-hand ~₹86,000 after 10% NPS deduction).
official_perks: Government-funded residential quarters inside KV campus premises or central HRA (30%/20%/10% by city tier)
Summer Vacation (approx. 50 days), Autumn Break (approx. 10 days), and Winter Break (approx. 10 days) with full salary entitlement
Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) / KVS Medical Assistance Scheme across empanelled hospitals
Children Education Allowance (CEA) of ₹2,250 per month per child and free education in Kendriya Vidyalayas for children of KVS staff
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% defined monthly employer contribution by Government of India
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and Transfer Grant entitlements across pan-India postings
